#!/bin/bash

# Check if /tmp is already on a separate partition
if mount | grep -q " /tmp "; then
    echo "/tmp is already on a separate partition. No action needed."
    exit 0
fi

# Check if LVM is available and has free space
if ! command -v vgdisplay &> /dev/null || ! command -v lvcreate &> /dev/null; then
    echo "LVM tools not found. Cannot create a separate /tmp partition without LVM."
    exit 1
fi

FREE_SPACE=$(vgdisplay | grep "Free" | awk '{print $3}' | sed 's/[^0-9]*//g')
if [ "$FREE_SPACE" -lt 1024 ]; then
    echo "Insufficient free space in LVM volume group. Need at least 1GB."
    exit 1
fi

# Create a logical volume for /tmp
VG_NAME=$(vgdisplay | grep "VG Name" | awk '{print $3}')
LV_NAME="tmp_lv"
SIZE="1G"

lvcreate -L "$SIZE" -n "$LV_NAME" "$VG_NAME" || exit 1
mkfs.ext4 "/dev/$VG_NAME/$LV_NAME" || exit 1

# Backup existing /tmp data
mkdir -p /tmp_backup
cp -a /tmp/* /tmp_backup/ 2>/dev/null || true

# Mount the new /tmp partition
mount "/dev/$VG_NAME/$LV_NAME" /tmp || exit 1
chmod 1777 /tmp

# Restore /tmp data
cp -a /tmp_backup/* /tmp/ 2>/dev/null || true
rm -rf /tmp_backup

# Add entry to /etc/fstab for persistence
echo "/dev/$VG_NAME/$LV_NAME /tmp ext4 defaults,nodev,nosuid,noexec 0 0" >> /etc/fstab

echo "Successfully created and mounted a separate /tmp partition."

set -euo pipefail

TMP_DEVICE="/dev/nvme0n1p5"
TMP_MOUNT="/tmp"
FSTAB="/etc/fstab"

if ! grep -q "^$TMP_DEVICE" "$FSTAB" 2>/dev/null || ! grep -q "[[:space:]]$TMP_MOUNT[[:space:]]" "$FSTAB" 2>/dev/null; then
    if [ -b "$TMP_DEVICE" ]; then
        if ! findmnt -M "$TMP_MOUNT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            if mountpoint -q "$TMP_MOUNT"; then
                umount "$TMP_MOUNT"
            fi
            mount "$TMP_DEVICE" "$TMP_MOUNT"
        fi
        
        if ! grep -q "^$TMP_DEVICE[[:space:]].*[[:space:]]$TMP_MOUNT[[:space:]]" "$FSTAB"; then
            cp "$FSTAB" "${FSTAB}.bak.$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"
            if grep -q "[[:space:]]$TMP_MOUNT[[:space:]]" "$FSTAB"; then
                sed -i "\|[[:space:]]${TMP_MOUNT}[[:space:]]|d" "$FSTAB"
            fi
            echo "$TMP_DEVICE $TMP_MOUNT ext4 defaults,nosuid,nodev,noexec 0 0" >> "$FSTAB"
        fi
    else
        echo "ERROR: $TMP_DEVICE does not exist. Manual LVM/partition setup required." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
else
    if ! grep -q "^$TMP_DEVICE[[:space:]].*nosuid.*nodev.*noexec" "$FSTAB"; then
        cp "$FSTAB" "${FSTAB}.bak.$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"
        sed -i "s|^$TMP_DEVICE[[:space:]].*|$TMP_DEVICE $TMP_MOUNT ext4 defaults,nosuid,nodev,noexec 0 0|" "$FSTAB"
    fi
fi

if findmnt -M "$TMP_MOUNT" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    mount -o remount,nosuid,nodev,noexec "$TMP_MOUNT"
fi

#!/bin/bash
set -e

# Detect active firewall services
active_services=()
enabled_services=()

for svc in ufw iptables nftables; do
    if systemctl is-active --quiet "$svc" 2>/dev/null; then
        active_services+=("$svc")
    fi
    if systemctl is-enabled --quiet "$svc" 2>/dev/null; then
        enabled_services+=("$svc")
    fi
done

# If more than one is active, keep only ufw (Ubuntu default) or nftables as fallback
if [ "${#active_services[@]}" -gt 1 ]; then
    for svc in "${active_services[@]}"; do
        if [ "$svc" != "ufw" ]; then
            systemctl stop "$svc" 2>/dev/null || true
            systemctl disable "$svc" 2>/dev/null || true
        fi
    done
    # Ensure ufw is active if it was among the active ones, otherwise start it
    if [[ " ${active_services[*]} " =~ " ufw " ]]; then
        systemctl start ufw
        systemctl enable ufw
    else
        # Prefer nftables if ufw wasn't active
        for svc in "${active_services[@]}"; do
            [ "$svc" != "nftables" ] && systemctl stop "$svc" 2>/dev/null || true
        done
        systemctl start nftables 2>/dev/null || true
        systemctl enable nftables 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
fi

# Disable any other enabled firewall services
for svc in ufw iptables nftables; do
    if [ "$svc" != "ufw" ] && [ "$svc" != "nftables" ]; then
        systemctl disable "$svc" 2>/dev/null || true
    fi
done

# Ensure exactly one is enabled and active
if systemctl is-active --quiet ufw 2>/dev/null; then
    systemctl enable ufw 2>/dev/null || true
    # Disable others
    systemctl disable iptables 2>/dev/null || true
    systemctl disable nftables 2>/dev/null || true
elif systemctl is-active --quiet nftables 2>/dev/null; then
    systemctl enable nftables 2>/dev/null || true
    systemctl disable ufw 2>/dev/null || true
    systemctl disable iptables 2>/dev/null || true
else
    # Default to ufw on Ubuntu
    systemctl start ufw
    systemctl enable ufw
    systemctl disable iptables 2>/dev/null || true
    systemctl disable nftables 2>/dev/null || true
fi

# Verify
echo "Active firewall services:"
systemctl list-units --type=service --state=active | grep -E "(ufw|iptables|nftables)" || true
echo "Enabled firewall services:"
systemctl list-unit-files --state=enabled --type=service | grep -E "(ufw|iptables|nftables)" || true
